full_page.content:
1954, January 21
The following is a faithful transcription of handwritten original note added to a Seraphic Mass Association Pro- moters Certificate by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey, OFMCap.
-- Mrs. Martha .. O.B. -- Casey - -
Feast, of St. Agnes Fr. Begnignus a Sant' Ilario January 21, 1954 Min. General OFM Cap.
Signed/ Fr. Solanus OFMCap. God bless you Martha you and yours-Owen-all
How priviliged! How divine-like! -- Glory be to God! -- To help God -- rescue again what Jesus Christ died to save! That is being a missionary -- Promoter.
Ahl Thats being a real member of the privileged S.M.A.
!!! Blessed be God in all His deisgens!
